title: Layne's Revel Sales Summary
description: Credentials and report settings for the Layne's Revel Sales Summary.

url.title: Revel Sales Summary URL
url.description: URL of the Revel Sales Summary report.

username.title: Revel username
username.description: Username used to sign into Revel.

password.title: Revel password
password.description: Password used to sign into Revel.

establishment.title: Revel establishment
establishment.description: Establishment to select after login. The current Actor version supports Leander only.

override_flag.title: Override dates
override_flag.description: When enabled, the Actor uses override_startDate and override_endDate, which must be the same calendar day. When disabled, both dates are yesterday in US Central Time.

override_startDate.title: Override start date
override_startDate.description: Report date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Used for both the start and end date when override_flag is true. Must match override_endDate.

override_endDate.title: Override end date
override_endDate.description: Report date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Used for both the start and end date when override_flag is true. Must match override_startDate.

startTime.title: Start time
startTime.description: The current Actor uses 12:00 AM as the report start time.

startMeridiem.title: Start AM/PM
startMeridiem.description: The current Actor uses AM for the report start time.

endTime.title: End time
endTime.description: The current Actor uses 11:59 PM as the report end time.

endMeridiem.title: End AM/PM
endMeridiem.description: The current Actor uses PM for the report end time.
